title: BackendInstallProvenance
description: Host-side install provenance written by deploy bootstrap under versions/<version>/.seed/provenance.json (lp-k7g.7.4). Records the selected backend artifact and contract majors so operators and upgrade tooling can verify what is installed without re-reading Terraform state.

schema_version.description: Provenance document schema major. Bump only on breaking field changes.

version.description: Immutable release version label; equals the directory name under versions/.

url.description: Artifact object URL used for download (s3:// or https://).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the archive bytes as installed.

relay.description: Gateway relay contract major (BACKEND_CONTRACT_RELAY / legacy RELAY_CONTRACT_MAJOR).

installed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this version directory was last written by bootstrap.

install_path.description: Absolute path to this version directory (install_root/versions/<version>).

layout.description: Install layout mode used by bootstrap.

current_symlink.description: Absolute path of the current symlink when layout is versioned.

attestation_status.description: Optional Ed25519 attestation result for the archive (failed installs must not write this file).

attestation_alg.description: Signature algorithm when attestation ran (e.g. ed25519).

signing_pubkey_sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the signing public key DER when attestation verified.

signing_identity.description: Optional operator label for the signing key (ARTIFACT_SIGNING_IDENTITY).

entrypoint.description: Archive-relative gateway entrypoint if known (e.g. bin/company-brain-backend).

bootstrap.description: Install channel marker; parity with client-core seed provenance.
